name: bias_battery_motivation_mismatch_opener
hypothesis: Competitive team (>=40% prior win pct) facing a bad_team_late opponent -- subset cover rate vs. complement. Opener-grade re-screen of an already-recorded close-graded cell; mined family, uncorrected multiplicity; recorded for direction and pooling, not as a finding.

reliability_check.reason: motivation_mismatch is a per-game situational condition (this week's own record vs. the opponent's), not a persistent per-team trait -- there is nothing to split-half.
